note: Every `overrides` entry in every workspace package.json is a deliberate deviation from a dependency's declared graph, taken to INSTALL a fixed package rather than to suppress or weaken `npm audit`. This register is the machine-readable binding: each record names the exact package, the declared spec, the resolved lockfile version, the dependency ancestry, whether the package is reachable from a production root, the advisories the override clears today, an owner, and a mandatory review deadline. scripts/validate-dependency-overrides.js fails CI when a live override is unregistered, a record is stale, a version drifts, a dev-only claim is contradicted by the locked graph, or a review deadline has passed. `advisory_basis` separates an override that clears a CURRENT advisory from one that has become redundant upstream (HISTORICAL) — a redundant override is a silent permanent fork, so it must carry a near-term review deadline and a removal check. Prose records live in docs/DEPENDENCY-OVERRIDES.md and are referenced by `record`.
